title: Schematic netlist matches design.py
procedure: python3 hardware/ref_design/board/tools/check_netlist.py
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS (every part, value, footprint, LCSC number and net as design.py says)

title: Datasheet pin gate (every assembled part's pins and every passive's value and rating)
procedure: python3 hardware/ref_design/board/tools/check_pins.py
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS; no pin net changed since its review; no issue without a fix or waiver

title: ERC
procedure: kicad-cli sch erc --severity-all hardware/ref_design/board/battler.kicad_sch
pass_limit: 0 errors, 0 warnings

title: DRC with schematic parity
procedure: python3 hardware/ref_design/board/tools/check_pcb.py
pass_limit: 0 errors, 0 unconnected, 0 parity issues; silkscreen warnings only

title: Backlight current-sink simulation (ngspice, vendor models)
procedure: python3 hardware/ref_design/board/sim/models.py && python3 hardware/ref_design/board/sim/backlight.py (about 40 min)
pass_limit: phase margin >= 45 deg at every corner; DC <= 120 mA total; regulation within 5% from VSYS 3.5 V at Vf 3.2 V; off-state spike < 5 mA

title: Board inside the case (check_fit)
procedure: python3 hardware/ref_design/case/check_fit.py (after fab.py and case/export.py)
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS, no collisions, every part under its local limit
evidence: git show b2b9e27 (message: 'case fit: no collisions'); case/fit_report.txt is build output, not in git

title: Buttons work under the shell (check_buttons)
procedure: python3 hardware/ref_design/case/check_buttons.py (about 6 min)
pass_limit: every check passes for both lids: pads clear the shell, caps sit and press without touching it, D-pad rocks 8 ways
evidence: git show 269dc87 (message: the check passes and was shown to fail on a cap that does not fit its slot)

title: Contact footprint geometry, DSL_button_4ring (ref_design library)

pass_limit: min copper gap >= 0.20 mm; bridging spot <= 1.60 mm; mask opening covers all copper; each pad one piece

title: Contact footprint geometry, DSL_button_3ring (Start/Select)
procedure: python3 hardware/membrane/tools/check_contact_fp.py hardware/ref_design/board/lib/battler.pretty/DSL_button_3ring.kicad_mod
pass_limit: min copper gap >= 0.20 mm; bridging spot <= 1.60 mm; mask opening covers all copper

title: Contact footprint geometry, DSL_button_4ring (prod_board library)
procedure: python3 hardware/membrane/tools/check_contact_fp.py hardware/prod_board/prod_board/prod.pretty/DSL_button_4ring.kicad_mod
pass_limit: min copper gap >= 0.20 mm; bridging spot <= 1.60 mm; mask opening covers all copper

title: Unplug hand-over simulation (USB to cell; D7, Q2, R38, C9; derated caps)
procedure: not in the repo: the Python ODEs behind design_review.md 'The unplug' were never committed; commit them under board/sim/
pass_limit: 3V3 >= 2.97 V through the hand-over at a 3.50 V cell, full backlight and audio; Q2 on within 5 ms

title: Hot-plug ringing simulation (2 m cable, no cell; R41, R47, C1, D5)
procedure: not in the repo: the ODEs behind design_review.md 'The input' were never committed; commit them under board/sim/
pass_limit: VBUS <= 7.5 V; VSYS <= 5.8 V; PWR_EN <= VSYS + 0.3 V at every instant

title: Copper resistance and IR drop on the power paths (IPC-2152)
procedure: not in the repo: the copper solves quoted in validation_plan #17/#145 predate the 2026-10-19 re-route; write board/tools/check_copper.py
pass_limit: drop VBUS->VSYS <= 50 mV and VBAT->VSYS <= 30 mV at 0.75 A; every power track within IPC-2152 for a 10 C rise

title: LCSC identity: C-number -> MPN, package, pin count, rating, stock class
procedure: write board/tools/check_lcsc.py over design.py and the JLC parts database (validation_plan #2/#122)
pass_limit: 0 unexplained differences between design.py and the LCSC record for every line

title: GPIO function-mux check against the RP2350 function table
procedure: write board/tools/check_gpio.py: every GPIO's job is a function that pin has (Table 3); PWM slices and SPI0/UART1 pins agree
pass_limit: 0 GPIOs assigned a function the pin lacks; 0 shared PWM slice conflicts

title: RP2350 errata table for this design
procedure: write hardware/vv/evidence/errata_rp2350.md: each erratum (E1..), applies here?, fix, which stepping (A2/A4)
pass_limit: every erratum answered; every 'applies' row has a fix or a waiver

title: DRC against JLC's published 2-layer capability rules
procedure: write board/jlc_2layer.kicad_dru from JLC's capabilities page; kicad-cli pcb drc with it
pass_limit: 0 errors; the copied core's 0.10 mm spaces either allowed by JLC in writing or widened

title: Board-edge clearance of copper and parts; edge rails
procedure: write board/tools/check_edge.py (pcbnew): copper and part bodies to Edge.Cuts
pass_limit: copper >= 0.30 mm from the edge; no part body over the edge except J1 by design; J5/J6 at 0.12 mm resolved

title: Placement drift: board positions vs placement.py and positions.json
procedure: write board/tools/check_placement.py (pcbnew vs placement.py + case/positions.json)
pass_limit: every placed part within 0.05 mm and 0.1 deg of where the scripts put it

title: Case stack worst case and RSS (Z with swelling; XY pill to comb)
procedure: write case/check_stack.py: every term of case.scad's STACK echo with its vendor tolerance; XY chain pill->comb
pass_limit: Z: >= 0.2 mm margin worst case incl. 0.4 mm cell swelling; XY: pill centre within 0.9 mm of the comb centre

title: Return paths: SPI, USB and PWM tracks over B.Cu pour gaps
procedure: write board/tools/check_return.py (pcbnew: sample F.Cu segments of the nets, test the B.Cu fill under them)
pass_limit: 0 gaps longer than 2 mm under LCD_SCK, LCD_MOSI, USB_DP, USB_DM, AUDIO_PWM

title: Seeded faults: prove each checker can fail
procedure: write hardware/vv/tools/seed_faults.py: one seeded fault per checker on a scratch copy (netlist, pins, DRC, fit, trace)
pass_limit: each checker exits non-zero on its seeded fault and zero on the clean copy

title: Copied core against Raspberry Pi's RP2350B minimal design (RP-010329)
procedure: write board/tools/check_core.py: netlist and geometry diff of the copied core (pads, vias, VREG_LX copper, decoupling)
pass_limit: 0 unexplained differences; the second 4.7 uF on +1V1 question answered

title: Fab outputs: hash, reproducibility, one commit
procedure: write board/tools/check_fab.py: run fab.py twice, diff the gerbers, sha256 the zip, record tools versions
pass_limit: two runs give identical copper and drill files; the zip's sha256 is in the release record; gerbers newer than the board

title: Gerbers: membrane combs and keep-outs
procedure: write board/tools/check_combs.py over the gerbers: paste, mask, silk and vias at each contact
pass_limit: no paste, silk or mask over any comb; mask opening 4.8 mm; no via or pour within 2.9 mm of a contact centre

title: Independent connectivity: IPC-D-356 netlist sent with the order, JLC e-test
procedure: add IPC-D-356 export to fab.py; tick 'netlist test' on the order; keep JLC's e-test report
pass_limit: file exported from the ordered board; JLC e-test 100% pass on every board

title: Independent gerber view (gerbv), EP paste and drill check
procedure: open battler_gerbers.zip in gerbv; compare each layer with kicad-cli renders; read the drill table and EP paste
pass_limit: every layer present and aligned; PTH/NPTH as intended; drills 0.3/0.6/0.65/2.2 mm only; EP paste 50-80%

title: JLC dry run: upload, parts match, placement preview, DFM report
procedure: upload gerbers, BOM and CPL at jlcpcb.com; stop before payment; screenshot every polarised part (incl. U1, D7, L2, J3)
pass_limit: every LCSC line matched; every polarised part's pin 1 as the silk; DFM report clean; screenshots in the release record

title: CPL rotation table against JLC's library footprints
procedure: write board/tools/check_rotation.py: KiCad zero vs JLC/EasyEDA footprint zero per footprint; corrected CPL angles
pass_limit: 0 unexplained offsets; U1 (C13612) offset settled (eea0ee8 and 1fd0956 disagree)

title: MLCC DC-bias derating, then re-run the unplug and hot-plug sims
procedure: table per CAP MPN from Samsung/Murata curves; feed derated values into VER-11 and VER-12
pass_limit: effective C at bias recorded for C1, C9, C5-C7, C24/C25; both sims still meet their limits

title: Ratings and derating table per part and mode; 3V3 budget
procedure: extend pin_review ratings into one table: off, cell, USB, charging, hot plug, unplug; sum the 3V3 load
pass_limit: every stress <= 80% of absolute max (90% for < 10 us) or a waiver; 3V3 load <= 150 mA; U3 <= 0.20 W

title: Charge-temperature window Monte Carlo (TH1, R39, R40, TP4056 thresholds)
procedure: write board/sim/temp_window.py: 1% resistors, TH1 +-1% R25 and B tolerance, TP4056 43-45% / 80-82%
pass_limit: 99.9% of units pause above 45 C +-3 C and below 0 C +-3 C (or the cell's own range)

title: Power latch state table: PWR_EN, pill resistance, leakage margins
procedure: write board/sim/latch.py: (Start, PWR_HOLD, VBUS) -> CE voltage with diode drops, R13/R15/R42, Q1 Vth spread
pass_limit: on with 10 kohm pill at VSYS 3.5 V; off with 1 Mohm leakage at 4.2 V; off after reset with E9 at 2.2 V

title: Application-circuit diff per IC and primary-source audit of inherited claims
procedure: for each IC: datasheet application circuit vs design.py, one line per difference with the reason
pass_limit: every difference explained; the four inherited claims (#196) cited or marked open

title: Datasheet archive with hashes
procedure: download every datasheet named in pin_review/*.json and SOURCES.md; record sha256 in hardware/vv/evidence/datasheets.txt
pass_limit: every reviewed part has a datasheet file whose sha256 is recorded (PDFs stay out of git)

title: Pin-review open questions and unknown ratings fail the gate
procedure: extend check_pins.py: fail on a rating with ok null, or 'OPEN QUESTION' / 'UNKNOWN' / 'MISMATCH' text with no resolution
pass_limit: 0 open questions, 0 unknown ratings (today: VREG_AVDD 3.135 V, +1V1 second 4.7 uF, U3 budget, D5 IFSM, R47 inrush, U2 BAT abs max)

title: Cell spec sheet: capacity, charge current, charge temperature, PCM values, size
procedure: get the MYWAY 403450 spec sheet; record it in hardware/vv/evidence/cell_403450.md; recompute R5
pass_limit: capacity, standard charge current >= 364 mA, charge 0-45 C or tighter, OVP/UVP/OCP, 34 x 50 x 4.0 mm with PCM

title: Cell transport documents (UN38.3 test summary, MSDS)
procedure: ask the cell vendor for the UN38.3 test summary and MSDS of the exact model
pass_limit: both documents in hand for the cell model and lot

title: Docs match the design (stale-doc sweep)
procedure: read README, PLAN, docs/*.md and the pin-review notes against design.py and case.scad; list each mismatch
pass_limit: 0 statements that disagree with design.py, case.scad or a check's output
evidence: hardware/vv/defects.md DEF-21 (eleven stale statements found while seeding this register)

title: Clean-room schematic review by a human who has not seen the notes
procedure: post the schematic PDF to r/PrintedCircuitBoard or EEVblog with no design notes; allow a week
pass_limit: replies read; every point answered in hardware/vv/evidence/cleanroom.md

title: Order-day stock, no substitution, pre-orders
procedure: JLC BOM page on order day; confirm RP2354B and L2 pre-ordered or consigned; 'do not substitute' on every line
pass_limit: stock >= quantity x 1.1 + attrition on every line; L2 and RP2354B are the designed parts

title: Release record complete
procedure: fill hardware/vv/releases/REL-<board>-R<rev>-<phase>.md from releases/TEMPLATE.md
pass_limit: tag, commit, fab zip sha256, locked BOM, no-substitution list, gate output, waivers, order options all filled

title: Real panel lit through a bottom-contact FPC breakout with design.py's J3 map
procedure: wire an ER-TFT035IPS-6 to a Pico 2 through a 0.5 mm 50-pin bottom-contact breakout using J3 pin j = panel 51-j
pass_limit: backlight lights at 20 mA; ID4 reads 0x94 0x88; a colour fill shows no missing line

title: Panel FPC tail thickness and width against the FH12-50S
procedure: calipers (about $15 if not owned) on the stiffened tail at three points

title: Comb coupon: pill resistance on ENIG
procedure: JLC ENIG coupon of DSL_button_4ring and 3ring; press a DS Lite pill with a 1 N weight; DMM ohms
pass_limit: < 1 kohm on every contact, 10 presses each

title: Comb leakage at 4.2 V, clean and after humidity
procedure: 4.2 V from the bench supply through the comb into a DMM on volts (10 Mohm input); read the leakage from the divider
pass_limit: >= 100 Mohm (DMM reads <= 0.38 V) clean, after a damp-cloth wipe and after 24 h in a sealed box with a wet sponge

title: Latch replica on SOT-23 breakouts (disputed: Fable only)
procedure: build Q1, D2, D3, R13-R15, R42, U3 from the real LCSC parts; drive PWR_HOLD from a Pico 2 through a watchdog reset
pass_limit: holds and releases at VSYS 3.5 and 4.2 V; starts with 1 kohm in series with the button

title: Printed case with real parts: fit, snap, screws, caps, panel in the lid
procedure: print the current tub and lid (case/print); fit board mock, cell, speaker, silicone, caps, panel; close with 6 screws
pass_limit: closes without force; caps 1.85 +-0.2 mm proud and free; panel window aligned within 0.5 mm; nothing rattles

title: Cell incoming inspection per lot
procedure: every cell: DMM on the plug (red lead on J2 pin 1 '+'), OCV; one per lot: calipers with its PCM
pass_limit: 100% polarity correct; OCV 3.6-4.0 V as shipped; size within 34 x 50 x 4.0 mm +0.3

title: Button force and travel against a genuine DS Lite
procedure: kitchen scale (0.1 g) under the cap, press until the pill closes (DMM continuity); depth gauge or calipers for travel
pass_limit: force within +-30% of the genuine DS Lite measured the same way; travel within +-0.2 mm

title: Pill-to-comb XY registration measured
procedure: ink the pills, press each button once on the board mock, measure the print against the comb centre (loupe, calipers)
pass_limit: every pill print centred within 0.9 mm of its comb centre

title: BU-0 unpowered resistances to GND (TP1-TP4) and VBUS-VBAT
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 0 (DMM)
pass_limit: TP1 about 0.8-1.0 kohm (R38 1k in parallel with the TEMP divider and the D5/D6 paths), TP2-TP4 > 1 kohm once the caps charge, TP1-TP3 > 10 kohm; none a short

title: BU-0 diode test VBAT<->VSYS in both directions
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 0 (DMM diode range)
pass_limit: TP3(+) to TP2: 0.15-0.35 V (D7 in parallel with Q2's body diode); TP2(+) to TP3: open. bringup.md today says one body-diode drop: wrong (DEF-21)

title: BU-0 cell polarity at J2 before mating
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 0; hardware/ref_design/docs/assembly.md section 2
pass_limit: red lead on J2 pin 1 '+', checked with a DMM, every cell

title: BU-1 USB only, no cell
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 1 (USB power meter)
pass_limit: VBUS 4.75-5.25 V; VSYS 4.5-4.7 V; 3V3 3.20-3.40 V; input < 40 mA; RP2350 drive appears within 5 s

title: BU-2.1 all 20 buttons read, alone and together
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 2.1 with the self-test image
pass_limit: each contact reads pressed when its combs are shorted and released otherwise; any 4 at once read correctly

title: BU-2.2/2.3 ADC7 and charger status pins
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md steps 2.2-2.3
pass_limit: ADC7 reads; CHG_STAT_N and CHG_DONE_N read with pull-downs off

title: BU-2.4 SWD through J5 and J7, UART through J6
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 2.4
pass_limit: probe-rs attaches through J5 and J7; UART text at 115200 8N1 through J6 with the Debug Probe cable

title: BU-2.5 revision strap
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 2.5
pass_limit: REV3..REV0 = BOARD_REV (1) with pull-ups on

title: BU-3.1-3.3 panel init, ID, colour
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md display steps 1-3
pass_limit: ID4 = 0x94 0x88 at <= 5 MHz; red, green, blue, white fills correct, no missing lines

title: BU-3.4 SPI write speed
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md display step 4
pass_limit: 10 full frames of a checker pattern at 20 MHz with 0 corrupted pixels at the far edge

title: BU-3.5 backlight current, balance, step response, headroom
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md display step 5; first light with JP2 cut and a DMM on mA across it
pass_limit: 80%: 99 +-5 mV on R52 and R53, within 3 mV of each other; 100%: <= 120 mA total; 18<->95% step: no ringing on the scope; 3.5 V cell at 100%: drop <= 5%

title: BU-3.6 tearing-effect pulse
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md display step 6
pass_limit: one pulse per frame, 60 Hz +-10%

title: BU-4 audio: level, carrier, wake, heat, noise
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 4; scope across SPK_P/SPK_N (two probes, A-B); thermocouple on U7
pass_limit: >= 0.35 W into 8 ohm at 1 kHz on a 3.8 V cell; carrier >= 40 dB down; full output <= 150 ms after AMP_EN; U7 top <= 85 C after 10 min full scale on USB; no audible whine in silence

title: BU-5.1 off-state cell current
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.1 (DMM on uA across cut JP5)
pass_limit: <= 30 uA at 25 C, cell 3.7-4.2 V, device off, no USB

title: BU-5.2 charge current and CHG_OFF pause
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.2 (DMM on A across cut JP5)
pass_limit: 300-400 mA into a cell at 3.6-3.9 V; CHG_OFF high stops it within 1 s; low resumes

title: BU-5.3 ADC against a meter; CV at charge-done; bench-supply sweep
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.3; then the bench supply in place of the cell, 3.0-4.2 V in 0.1 V steps
pass_limit: computed VBAT within 50 mV of the DMM above 3.6 V; VBAT 4.158-4.242 V at CHG_DONE_N low

title: BU-5.4 charger heat and TEMP level
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.4 (thermocouple on U2)
pass_limit: TEMP = 0.63 +-0.03 x VBUS at 25 C; still >= 0.50 x VBUS after 10 min of charging in the closed case

title: BU-5.4a charge pauses outside the temperature window
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.4a (hair dryer, cold pack, thermocouple next to TH1)
pass_limit: pauses at 45 +-3 C rising and at 0 +-3 C falling; resumes in range; repeat on every unit

title: BU-5.5 unplug hand-over on the scope; 100 unplugs with a flash check
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.5; scope on TP4, TP2 and TP7 (LS_GATE); cell emulated at 3.50 V by the bench supply
pass_limit: 3V3 >= 2.97 V throughout (and record its minimum against 3.135 V); Q2 on within 5 ms; 100 unplugs with no reset and no flash CRC error

title: BU-5.6 hot plug with no cell
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.6 (A-to-C cable from an always-on USB-A port)
pass_limit: VBUS <= 7.5 V; VSYS <= 5.8 V (bringup.md says 6.5 V, which ignores the FM8002A's 6.0 V: DEF-06)

title: BU-5.7 ME6211 CE at a live plug-in
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.7 (scope TP6 and TP2, math TP6-TP2)
pass_limit: PWR_EN - VSYS <= +0.3 V at every instant, 10 plug-ins

title: BU-6 power switch: on, latch, off, reset
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 6 (bringup.md 6.2-6.3 still say Y: DEF-21)
pass_limit: on only after Start held 1.0 +-0.2 s; off after a long press; RESET turns it off on the cell; off current back <= 30 uA

title: First power with JP1 cut (catch a wrong LDO before it reaches the chip)
procedure: add to bringup.md step 1: unit 1 with JP1 cut, USB through a 100 mA limit, DMM on 3V3_LDO; then bridge JP1
pass_limit: 3V3_LDO 3.20-3.40 V before JP1 is bridged

title: Chip identity and stepping, logged per unit
procedure: picotool info -a (chip ID, package, stepping, flash JEDEC ID) at first boot; write it to the unit's record
pass_limit: RP2354B, 2 MB flash; stepping recorded (A2 means E9 applies to AMP_EN and BL_PWM)

title: Production self-test image
procedure: write a self-test UF2: buttons, GPIO neighbour-bridge test, panel ID and fills, backlight, audio tone, ADC, charger states incl. blinking, REV strap; PASS/FAIL per item on the UART; no OTP or flash-security writes
pass_limit: every item PASS on a good unit and FAIL on a seeded fault (a shorted button, a panel unplugged); <= 5 min a unit

title: PWR_HOLD release after reset and crash on the real board
procedure: scope GPIO2 (PWR_HOLD) and TP6 through RESET, a watchdog reset and a hard fault, on the cell
pass_limit: PWR_HOLD < 0.5 V within 10 ms; 3V3 < 0.5 V within 200 ms of Start released

title: Start with 1 kohm in series still turns the device on
procedure: 1 kohm across SW21's combs instead of the pill; bench supply as the cell at 3.50 V
pass_limit: 3V3 >= 3.20 V within 50 ms; PWR_BTN_N reads low

title: Start leakage immunity and per-unit comb leakage
procedure: 1 Mohm across SW21's combs, cell at 4.2 V, no USB; then each unit's SW21 leakage as VER-46
pass_limit: the device stays off (3V3 < 0.5 V) for 10 min; every unit's SW21 >= 100 Mohm

title: USB sources, cables and orientations
procedure: both plug orientations on a USB-C charger, a PD charger, an A-to-C cable from a PC and from a hub, the bench supply at a 500 mA limit; 5 cables
pass_limit: charges and enumerates in both orientations on every source; no limit cycling at 500 mA; every cable seats fully, case closed

title: Input current from a default-power USB port
procedure: USB power meter between a PC's USB-A port and the device, charging a flat cell with the backlight at 100%
pass_limit: <= 500 mA within 2 s of plug-in once firmware has read CC (the decision on legacy hosts is open: REQ-PWR-12)

title: Latent single-fault screen of the charge path (D6, Q2, D7)
procedure: with USB in: DMM on TP7 (LS_GATE) and TP2; after charge-done plus 1 h on USB: DMM on TP3; diode test as VER-53
pass_limit: LS_GATE within 0.4 V of VBUS; VBAT <= 4.25 V after 1 h at charge-done; diode test as VER-53; every unit

title: 3V3 regulation and 3V3 load
procedure: bench supply into VBUS (USB-C breakout) and as the cell 3.6-4.2 V; DMM on mA across cut JP1 at idle and at the self-test's heaviest load
pass_limit: 3V3 3.20-3.40 V at every point; 3V3 load <= 150 mA

title: 1V1 core rail level and ripple
procedure: scope on TP9 (1V1), 20 MHz limit, ground spring, at idle and at full CPU load
pass_limit: within the RP2350's DVDD range (Table 1688: write the values into this row on first use) including ripple

title: Cell surface temperature over a full charge in the closed case
procedure: K-type thermocouple taped to the cell (a DMM with a thermocouple input, about $25 if not owned); log every minute; 25 C room, then a 35 C box
pass_limit: <= 45 C at 25 C ambient; <= the cell maker's charge maximum at 35 C

title: Touch temperature during charge-while-playing
procedure: thermocouples on the lid face over U2, the back over U7 and the hottest spot found by touch; 1 h charge-while-playing, backlight 100%, audio full scale
pass_limit: <= 43 C (target) at 25 C ambient; measured rise + the rated maximum ambient <= 48 C (IEC 62368-1 TS1 limit for plastic held 10 min to 8 h)

title: TH1 tracks the cell during charge
procedure: thermocouple on the cell; TH1 from the TEMP voltage (VER-68); one full charge
pass_limit: TH1 within 5 C of the cell surface throughout

title: Cell protection (PCM) trip test on a spare pack
procedure: bench supply into the pack: raise to find OVP, discharge through a resistor to find UVP, short through 0.1 ohm for OCP
pass_limit: OVP 4.25-4.35 V; UVP 2.4-3.0 V; OCP trips (or the spec sheet's values) on one pack per lot

title: Assembled-board inspection under the microscope (IPC-A-610 Class 2)
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/assembly.md section 3.2 extended: QFN-80 edges, ESOP and SOT leads, 0402s, J1 pin row, J3 pins, every polarised mark vs silk
pass_limit: no bridge, tombstone, lifted lead or missing part; every pin 1 as the silk; every unit

title: Board flatness on arrival
procedure: board on a glass plate, feeler gauges (about $5) at the corners
pass_limit: bow and twist <= 0.75% (1.1 mm over 151 mm)

title: Hand assembly demo and time study
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/assembly.md sections 3-5 on one unit, timed, ESD mat and strap (about $15)
pass_limit: one unit in <= 30 min with an iron, a screwdriver and a knife; no part damaged; cell and panel each swap in <= 10 min

title: Case open/close cycling
procedure: 20 open/close cycles with the six screws, as assembly.md step 8
pass_limit: no cracked hook, no stripped boss; lid still seats

title: Drop test
procedure: 3 drops from 1.0 m onto hardwood on the face, an end and a corner (IEC 62368-1 Annex T.7, to confirm)
pass_limit: still works; no crack that exposes the cell or a board; cell moved <= 1 mm; plug and FPC still seated

title: Button life cycling
procedure: a hobby servo and a Pico press one button of each type (about $10 of parts)
pass_limit: 100,000 presses with contact resistance staying < 1 kohm

title: ESD screen
procedure: IEC 61000-4-2 gun (borrow from a makerspace or rent; none owned) on the USB-C shell, seams and button gaps
pass_limit: +-4 kV contact, +-8 kV air: no damage; recovers by itself or by a power cycle

title: Near-field emissions pre-scan
procedure: H-field probe set (about $25, or a loop of coax) on the scope's FFT over the board, case open and closed
pass_limit: the five largest peaks named with their source; none from a net that should be quiet

title: Margins and abuse on a sacrificial board
